scope.mission: Collect external methods, technical analogies, diagnostic instruments, negative results and search improvements that may help the separate JANUS algorithm-development dialogue.

ARTMONEY.mapping: Repeatedly filter explicit observed state components by predicates on how they changed between controlled runs.
ARTMONEY.allowed: Diagnostic localization over already materialized JANUS states and traces.
ARTMONEY.forbidden: Treating the technique as polynomial search over an implicit 2^n SAT assignment space.

mapping: compare_by_content = compare canonical structure/content, not only names or addresses
synchronize_dirs_preview = reconcile inventories and expose missing/changed/extra objects without applying changes
hide_equal = remove identical state regions from the analyst view
quick_filter = restrict the view to one clause/reason/resource family
duplicate_search = collapse repeated identical artifacts while retaining multiplicity provenance
checksums = integrity/provenance screening; exact canonical equality remains the authority
partial_branch_view = inspect only the dependency cone or branch around first divergence
plugins/custom_fields = extend SPIDER extractors without changing the algorithm
TOTAL_COMMANDER.allowed: Read-only diagnostic shell and research UI/data model.
TOTAL_COMMANDER.forbidden: Synchronizing or copying external research conclusions into solver state, changing proof transitions, or making UI similarity evidence.

scientific_routes.finding: Passing and failing executions can be compared as sequences of states; controlled altered executions can narrow relevant variables and values into a cause-effect chain.
Total Commander exposes two side-by-side file panes, compare-by-content, directory synchronization, quick filtering, duplicate search, custom columns/plugins and tree/branch-oriented navigation.
Synchronize dirs can compare directory trees by content and hide/show equal files.
Rsync identifies matching blocks and sends only unmatched material, using a cheap rolling checksum as a screen and a stronger checksum for candidate matches.
Content-defined chunking plus Merkle indexing can localize changed blocks and avoid reprocessing unchanged content.
Tree-structured differences can be formulated as an optimization problem that yields correct minimal type-safe edit scripts in that framework.
Likely invariants can be inferred dynamically from execution traces.
Dynamic slicing follows dependencies from an observed failure and can complement ranked fault localization; a hybrid strategy performed best in the reported study.
A trace-first debugger organizes understanding around execution history rather than isolated snapshots.
Comparing dynamic executions can highlight where an incorrect trace diverges from an expected trace.
Merkle-DAGs combine content addressing, deduplication, synchronization and provenance-friendly history structures.

combined_diagnostic_model.name: DUAL_PANE_DIFFERENTIAL_FORENSICS
steps: Freeze GOOD/reference and BAD/hostile traces without changing the algorithm.
Align comparable execution points by deterministic event identity or explicit alignment metadata.
Build canonical inventories of clauses, variables, reasons, proof nodes, cache keys, resource counters and dependency edges.
Hash/index inventories so byte-identical or canonically-identical regions can be skipped quickly.
Hide equal regions; display only added, removed, changed, reordered and missing objects.
Run ArtMoney-style differential narrowing only through validity-preserving perturbations of the generator/transition trace.
Intersect the surviving differential slice with proof/dependency slices and invariant-break locations.
Export the intersection as an obstruction candidate for the separate algorithm dialogue.
Never automatically modify algorithm code or promote the candidate to a theorem.

spider_self_improvements_allowed: content-addressed storage and Merkle-style subtree fingerprints
plugin-like extractors for new document/trace formats
handoff manifests for the separate algorithm dialogue
spider_forbidden_actions: insert a SAT/MaxSAT/SMT oracle into the target runtime
rewrite proof lemmas or theorem status
select a new algorithmic route because an external paper ranks highly
apply synchronize/copy operations back into algorithm state
treat hashes as semantic equality without exact canonical verification where required
